newsitem.title: UK: Humphrey the Downing Street cat is safe.
newsitem.headline: Humphrey the Downing Street cat is safe.

text.p: Humphrey the Downing Street cat is safe.
The official mouser in Britain's corridors of power will not be a casualty of last week's landslide election victory of new prime minister Tony Blair, government sources said on Friday.

There had been fears that black and white Humphrey might have to go because Blair's wife Cherie thought cats were unhygienic. The Blair children, Euan, Nicholas and Kathryn, have been forbidden to own pets.
Humphrey first appeared in Downing Street, where the prime minister lives and works, eight years ago and was adopted by then prime minister Major and his wife Norma.
In a gesture of reconciliation, Cherie hugged Humphrey for the benefit of the cameras on Friday, smiling despite getting white cat hairs all over her chic black jacket.
"Humphrey is safe," said a government official, who disclosed that Downing Street had been inundated with letters and calls following "mistaken" reports that Cherie wanted the cat out.
